review.posthog_relevance: Adds dashboard tile configuration and access-controlled entry points for dashboard creation, potentially improving user experience and permission enforcement.
review.reason: The observed changes introduce a ButtonTileCard component and its associated modal, along with DashboardPlacement and DashboardTile types, while also replacing the dashboard empty-state button with an access-controlled wrapper. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement in the dashboard configuration and user interaction flow.
review.uncertainty: The complete implementation and validation of these changes are not fully available, and the actual benefit to PostHog users cannot be independently verified.
